**Looking for a Trusted Gynaecologist in Borivali?**

Your reproductive and women's health deserves expert attention at every stage of life. Whether you're dealing with irregular periods, PCOS, pregnancy care, menopause, or routine gynaecological check-ups, timely medical care can make all the difference.

Common reasons to visit a gynaecologist include:
• Irregular or painful periods
• PCOS and hormonal imbalance
• Pregnancy planning and antenatal care
• Menopause-related concerns
• Preventive women's health check-ups

Early consultation helps identify concerns before they become serious and supports better long-term health outcomes.

Trying to conceive but not seeing the results you hoped for? IUI (Intrauterine Insemination) may be a suitable fertility treatment for couples facing certain infertility challenges.

You may benefit from IUI if you have:
• Unexplained infertility
• Mild male factor infertility
• Ovulation-related issues
• Cervical factor infertility
• Difficulty conceiving naturally after trying for several months

IUI is a simple, minimally invasive fertility procedure that places specially prepared sperm directly into the uterus to improve the chances of pregnancy.

Every fertility journey is unique. Read our full blog to understand how IUI works, who it is suitable for, and what to expect during treatment.

Irregular periods, pelvic pain, unusual discharge, or persistent menstrual discomfort should never be ignored. These symptoms may indicate an underlying gynecological condition that requires timely medical attention.

A gynecologist can help with:
• Irregular or painful periods
• PCOS and hormonal imbalances
• Pregnancy and prenatal care
• Menopause management
• Routine women's health check-ups

Early diagnosis and the right treatment can help prevent complications and improve your overall reproductive health.

If you're experiencing any of these concerns, consult an experienced gynecologist for personalized care.

**Irregular Periods? It Could Be PCOD**

Irregular periods, unexplained weight gain, acne, or excessive hair growth may be signs of Polycystic Ovarian Disease (PCOD). Early diagnosis and the right treatment can help manage symptoms and improve your overall reproductive health.

Common signs of PCOD include:
• Irregular or missed periods
• Weight gain or difficulty losing weight
• Acne and oily skin
• Excess facial or body hair
• Difficulty conceiving

PCOD is a manageable condition with the right combination of medical care, lifestyle changes, and regular follow-up.

High-Risk Pregnancy? Expert Care Can Make All the Difference

A high-risk pregnancy requires specialized monitoring and timely medical support to help ensure the health of both mother and baby.

Some factors that may make a pregnancy high-risk include:
• High blood pressure during pregnancy
• Gestational diabetes
• Multiple pregnancy (twins or more)
• Maternal age above 35 years
• Previous pregnancy complications

Early diagnosis, regular prenatal check-ups, and expert obstetric care can help manage potential risks and support a safer pregnancy journey.

If you have concerns about your pregnancy, consult an experienced obstetrician for personalized guidance and care.

In some cases, uterus removal surgery (hysterectomy) may be the right treatment option when medications or other treatments no longer provide relief.

• Pain affecting daily activities

Early consultation and the right medical guidance can help you understand the best treatment options available for your condition.

IUI (Intrauterine Insemination) is a simple and minimally invasive fertility treatment that helps improve the chances of pregnancy by placing healthy sperm directly into the uterus during ovulation.

You may benefit from IUI treatment if you are facing:

Early fertility evaluation can make a difference. Know your options and take the next step with expert care.

Planning your motherhood journey? Choosing the right maternity hospital can make all the difference.

At Saukhyam Hospital, we provide compassionate maternity care for every stage of pregnancy — from prenatal check-ups to delivery and postnatal support.

Signs you shouldn’t ignore during pregnancy:

• Severe back or abdominal pain
• Reduced baby movements

Our experienced team is here to support you with personalised care, advanced facilities, and guidance for a safe and comfortable pregnancy journey.

Your reproductive health plays a major role in your overall well-being. Regular check-ups can help detect and manage concerns like PCOS, infections, pregnancy-related issues, menstrual disorders, and menopause symptoms at the right time.

**Strategies to Improve Egg Quality and Number of Eggs**

Egg quality and egg number are crucial factors for successful conception, whether natural or through IVF. Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.
How to Improve Endometrial Thickness:

For pregnancy to occur, the uterus needs a healthy inner lining called the endometrium, where the embryo attaches and grows. In some women, this lining remains thin despite medicines, hormones, or fertility treatments. A thin endometrium can reduce the chances of embryo implantation, especially during IVF.

Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are an advanced treatment option for women who do not respond to routine therapies. These special cells have the ability to repair and regenerate damaged tissues. They are usually obtained from safe sources such as the placenta or umbilical cord.

When MSCs are introduced into the uterus, they help improve blood flow, reduce scarring, and promote the growth of healthy endometrial tissue. Unlike treatments that work temporarily, MSC therapy aims to improve the overall quality of the uterine lining.

This therapy may benefit women with very thin endometrium, scarring after infections or surgery, or repeated IVF failures due to poor endometrial growth. MSC therapy is considered a specialized option and is recommended only after proper evaluation and counseling by a fertility specialist.

Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs that can develop within or on the surface of the ovaries. **Could Your "Digestive Problem" Actually Be GI Tract Endometriosis?**

Many women with endometriosis experience bowel symptoms for years before receiving the correct diagnosis.

**GI tract endometriosis** most commonly affects the:
✅ Rectum
✅ Sigmoid colon
✅ Appendix
✅ Small intestine (ileum)
✅ Cecum
*Less commonly, it can involve the stomach or upper digestive tract.*

**Watch for these symptoms:**
🔹 Pain during bowel movements
🔹 Chronic pelvic or abdominal pain
🔹 Bloating and excessive gas
🔹 Constipation or diarrhea, especially during periods
🔹 Painful bowel movements
🔹 Rectal bleeding during menstruation (in some cases)

These symptoms are often mistaken for IBS or other digestive disorders. If your bowel symptoms become worse around your menstrual cycle, endometriosis could be the underlying cause.

Early diagnosis and expert care can relieve symptoms, preserve quality of life, and prevent disease progression. We offer comprehensive evaluation and advanced minimally invasive treatment tailored to each patient's needs.

Ovarian Chocolate Cyst (Endometrioma)

An ovarian chocolate cyst is a type of cyst formed due to endometriosis, where tissue similar to the inner lining of the uterus grows inside the ovary.
It contains old, dark blood—hence the name “chocolate cyst.”

• Pelvic pain, especially during periods
• Pain during intercourse
• Heavy or irregular periods
• Difficulty conceiving 
• Sometimes, no symptoms at all

Why It Matters?

If untreated, these cysts can grow, cause pain, and may affect fertility. Early diagnosis helps in better management.

• Medicines to control symptoms

Struggling to conceive? Endometriosis could be one reason—but understanding it is the first step.

🔴 What is Endometriosis?
Tissue similar to the uterine lining grows outside the uterus, causing pain, inflammation, and scarring.

⚠️ How it affects fertility:

🚧 Blocked Fallopian Tubes
Scar tissue can prevent egg & sperm from meeting.

🥚 Ovarian Damage
Cysts (endometriomas) may affect egg quality and release.

🔥 Inflammation
Creates a hostile environment for fertilization and embryo development.

🏠 Implantation Issues
The uterus may be less receptive to pregnancy.

💡 The Good News
Many women with endometriosis DO conceive—naturally or with the right treatment.

• Trying >1 year (<35 years)
